simple.summary: בּוּקָה (bûwqâh) means emptiness (as adjective) First listed occurrence: Nah 2 11.

definitions.full: H950. buqah בּוּקָה noun feminine emptiness , Nahum 2:11 וּמְבֻלָּקֱה וּמְבוּקָה בּוּקה emptiness and void and waste .
definitions.rootNote: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow);
